_source: Phase 09 T1.3 rules profile for Phantasie III (DOS SSI 1988 numbers; the III manual is the source of truth). Only decided or decoded values. III's training, terrain and encounter rules do not fit the I / II blocks (training / terrain / encounters are left out); their tables are in rule-tables.json for Core's III rules.
_gold: D3-026 (user s81: manual 65,000 per party and per account; DOS has no cap, an option).
_guild: D3-029 (user s81): no roster limit by default (manual 'dozens'); built as a rules option by Core's III rules. The numbers below are DOS's: 20 records, the 3 elementals in slots 0-2, so 17 characters (logic-specs/elementals.md). guild_by_platform.dos records the same.
_starting_gold: 0 here: III's starting gold is social class * 256 (rule-tables.json social_classes), added by III's creation rule (FORMAT.md section 5.1).
_equipment_slots: Manual (III PDF 6 / pr.6, 11-12) and DOS (ovl2 0x37f1) [C]: shield 1-20, armour 21-40, bow 41-60, melee weapon 61-100.
_elementals: Manual (III PDF 11 / pr.16, Q12: 'does not count as a member') and DOS (ovl2 0x3a0a) [C] agree: an elemental joins once the party has one character, and a character can still be added afterwards (the elemental stays last). drop_keeps: DOS ovl2 0x3c92 [C] (s97): dropping a character keeps the loaded elemental (it moves up and stays last) until no character is left; the manual is silent. logic-specs/elementals.md section 2.
_elementals_drop_purge: drops_elemental: DOS ovl2 0x3c92 [C]: Drop Member on the elemental clears the flag and filled_slots (logic-specs/elementals.md section 2). purge: D3-040 (user s99: the manual, as III's Drop) for the Manual / Remaster / Custom presets; purge_original: DOS refuses a party member (string 448, guild_menu 0xafe3) under the Original preset (user s172: III's elemental-purge = game follows the preset; the former p3.purge option is folded in).
_dungeon_save_per_dungeon: DOS writes one saved map per dungeon, DNP<letter> / DNG<letter> (ovl4 0x62d; live s82: the archives wrote DNPA / DNGA) [C]; logic-specs/dungeon-events.md section 1. The manual is silent on the files.
_drop_gold_share: Guild Drop Member pays the dropped character party_gold / characters (32-bit divide, the count taken before the Drop, the elemental not counted) into his bank account and takes it from the party gold: DOS ovl2 0x3c92 and Amiga 0xd448 [C] (s98). Apple II's Drop (town lines 3500-3520) moves no gold. The manual is silent (Guild: 'Drop From Party'), so not a conflict. logic-specs/town.md section 2.

dos._source: [C] static: roster FAR:0xe820 x 20 records, creation needs a count below 20, a new data disk starts with Air / Mist / Mud in slots 0-2 (root 0xa856, ovl2 0x3f04).
